editorial.blurb: Rojo Gusano brings vibrant Mexican cooking and genuine warmth to Ravenswood, with standout tacos, fresh salsas, and in-house horchata that keep regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the tacos—chicken tinga, pastor, and baja are crowd favorites—and ask them to make your Bloody Maria or margarita spicy; try the in-house horchata and café de olla for something special.
